title: Just Mercy
author: Bryan Stevenson
current_text: After a parent complained, the Yorkville Community Unit School District 115 Board of Education decided that Just Mercy could no longer be used as an anchor text for an English II unit, although it remained available to students in the library.

sources.quote: District 115 told Patch in a statement that the Board did not ban the book but decided, after a parent complained, to direct the interim superintendents to "inform the complainant and accused that Just Mercy, by Bryan Stephenson, may no longer be used as an anchor text to teach the English II unit, but the text will remain available to interested students in the library."
sources.title: Yorkville School Board Probed Over Book Ban, Open Meeting Complaint | Yorkville, IL Patch

sources.quote: This binding opinion is issued by the Attorney General pursuant to section 3.5(e) of the Open Meetings Act (OMA) (5 ILCS 120/3.5(e) (West 2022)). For the reasons discussed below, this office concludes that the Board of Education (Board) of Yorkville Community Unit School District 115 (District) violated section 2(a) of OMA
